community_list_entries.name: SuperMemory-VQA: An Egocentric Visual Question-Answering Benchmark for Long-Horizon Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Egocentric VQA dataset (52.9 hours of AI-glasses video, 4,853 QA pairs) for long-horizon personal memory: object and location, intent, scene, timeline and conversation recall, with an 'unanswerable' option on each question.
